Package sootup.callgraph

Interface LabeledCallGraph<L>

Type Parameters:
L - the type of the labels attached to the calls
All Superinterfaces:
CallGraph
All Known Subinterfaces:
MutableLabeledCallGraph<L>
All Known Implementing Classes:
LabeledGraphBasedCallGraph
public interface LabeledCallGraph<L> extends CallGraph
A call graph whose calls (edges) can carry labels of type L. The label type is not restricted, e.g. an enum, a record or a sealed interface to combine several kinds of labels: 

 enum Hotness { HOT, COLD }

 LabeledCallGraph<Hotness> cg = LabeledGraphBasedCallGraph.of(callGraph);
 Set<Hotness> labels = cg.getLabels(call);
Labels are compared with Object.equals(Object), so a label is stored at most once per call. Call graphs that do not need labels should keep using CallGraph, which has no overhead for labels.

      @NonNull Set<L> getLabels(@NonNull CallGraph.Call call)
      This method returns all labels attached to a call in the call graph.
      Parameters:
      call - the requested call in the call graph

      an unmodifiable set of the labels of the call. It is empty if the call has no labels or is not contained in the call graph.
